plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Add to QQQI, targeting 25% of the book, to favor income and capital preservation.
This plan significantly de-risks the portfolio by removing leveraged positions and increasing income exposure.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and concentrating in broad index and income. Expect lower volatility but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 2%, MUU to 3%, and METU to 2% to reduce overall leverage.
Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Buy META, targeting 4% of the book, as a high-scoring quality tech addition.
This plan balances risk and growth by reducing leverage while adding a strong new setup.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality tech name. Expect moderate volatility and growth, with a reduced risk of margin call compared to your current book.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL, MUU, and METU, targeting 7%, 6%, and 6% respectively, to lean into leveraged tech.
Buy META, targeting 6% of the book, and QCOM, targeting 5%, as high-scoring new setups.
This plan aggressively uses leverage and concentrates in high-scoring tech for maximum growth potential.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-scoring tech setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage the higher risk of substantial losses.

plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30% of the book, to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
This plan focuses on parking cash for yield by rotating into income ETFs and reducing high-beta names.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by cutting leverage and high-beta names, favoring income and broad index ETFs. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
